Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationSalt_Sali: About 5 kg of salty earth. Soak it with a full metal bucket of water, or of brine to make it stronger, for a leaching charge.
Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationSalt_Leac: Soaked saline soil, with a bucket to catch the brine. Load it into a Leaching Vat.
Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationSalt_Brin: Put this on a lit fire, stove or oven. It takes about four hours on a fire, and less in a hot oven. Taken off the heat before it is done, it is a bucket of brine again and starts over.
Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationSalt_Shak: Refill it with 2 Evaporated Salt, or from a Bag of Salt.
Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationSalt_Salt: The brine has boiled away. Scrape out the salt.
Tooltip_craft_leachingVatDesc: A wooden vat that slowly draws brine out of soaked saline soil. Outdoors only.
